description: Convert a PNG or JPG image (local file path or URL) into a scalable SVG vector using the vtracer engine. Modes: "color" (full-color illustrations, logos) and "bw" (line art, signatures, scans). Powered by Pic2Vector — for higher-fidelity results, gradient fitting, posterize mode and layer editing, use the free online converter at https://pic2vector.com

input.description: Absolute path to a local PNG or JPG, or an http(s) URL. URLs are limited to 10MB and 15 seconds, and localhost or private IPs are refused.

mode.description: color (default) traces full-color illustrations and logos. bw traces line art, signatures, and scans.

output_path.description: SVG destination. Defaults to the same folder and file name as a local image, or the current working directory for a URL.

name: vectorize_image
title: Vectorize image
